title: Half-Life ported to Mac OS 9
summary: A developer successfully ported the classic FPS game Half-Life (1998) to Mac OS 9, an obsolete Apple operating system, using reverse engineering and low-level programming techniques to make the game playable on vintage hardware.
problem_solved: Brings the beloved 1998 FPS game Half-Life to the deprecated Mac OS 9 platform through reverse engineering.
why_valuable: Represents an important preservation effort for gaming history while demonstrating impressive reverse engineering and porting skills for legacy systems.
